label: A possible contingent-free past from possible begun coming-to-be (inference)
rule: Take the first moment of the populated moment's past; coming to be excludes contingent occupants there
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A3 of the modal spine to God's existence, from a strictly weaker premise than the founded version. In the accessible history the contingent individual x is present at t, and some moment m at or before t has nothing earlier. m differs from t, because x present at m would need an earlier moment of absence; so m is strictly before t. Any contingent concrete individual present at m would likewise need an earlier moment, so m is free of contingent concrete individuals. No frame condition, presence contract, inertness of emptiness, well-foundedness or causal relation is used. The single premise is OPEN and is a possibility claim. It carries no price against continuous time: continuous time with a first moment satisfies it. Nothing is attributed to a source. No premise truth is established.
